d: A viral video showing an Israeli tourist pushing a Sri Lankan boat guide into the sea has sparked international outrage. The tourists have defended the incident as a harmless joke, but their response has drawn further backlash. The controversy comes amid rising Israeli tourist arrivals in Sri Lanka, with growing tensions in destinations such as Arugam Bay. From local protests and concerns over tourist activities to political pressure on the government, Firstpost examines why one shocking incident has reopened a much bigger debate about Israeli visitors, tourism and the rights of local…
